## Pull in compiled data and export annual files
```{r Pull in compiled data files, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}

#write out a csv of all the data to the main folder: 
final_data <- read.csv("../COMPASS_TEMPEST_TGW_AllData.csv")

final_data_2022 <- subset(final_data, Year == "2022")
final_data_2023 <- subset(final_data, Year == "2023")
final_data_2024 <- subset(final_data, Year == "2024")
# final_data_2025 <- subset(final_data, Year == "2025")

##Write out annual data files
write.csv(final_data_2022, "Data package/COMPASS_TEMPEST_TGW_2022.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(final_data_2023, "Data package/COMPASS_TEMPEST_TGW_2023.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(final_data_2024, "Data package/COMPASS_TEMPEST_TGW_2024.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# write.csv(final_data_2025, "Data package/COMPASS_TEMPEST_TGW_2025.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Create flmd file
```{r create flmd}

files  = list.files("Data package")
files

files = c("COMPASS_TEMPEST_TGW_2022.csv", "COMPASS_TEMPEST_TGW_2023.csv", "COMPASS_TEMPEST_TGW_2024.csv", "COMPASS_TEMPEST_TGW_2025.csv", "dd.csv")

flmd <- data.frame(file_name = files)
flmd

flmd$file_description <- ""
flmd$standard <- ""
flmd$file_version <- ""
flmd$data_orientation <- ""
flmd$header_rows <- ""
flmd$column_or_row_name_position <- ""
flmd$notes <- ""

#add information about each line:

flmd$file_description <-  c("Tree gas well data taken from COMPASS TEMPEST site in 2022",
                            "Tree gas well data taken from COMPASS TEMPEST site in 2023",
                            "Tree gas well data taken from COMPASS TEMPEST site in 2024",
                            "Tree gas well data taken from COMPASS TEMPEST site in 2025",
                            "Data dictionary file for annual redox data files describing each column in the dataset")

flmd$data_orientation <-  c("horizontal",
                            "horizontal",
                            "horizontal",
                            "horizontal",
                            "horizontal")

flmd$header_rows <-   c("1",
                        "1",
                        "1",
                        "1",
                        "1")

flmd$column_or_row_name_position <- c("1",
                                      "1",
                                      "1",
                                      "1",
                                      "1")


#write out the flmd associated with the data:
write.csv(flmd, "Data package/flmd.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Create site list - can we use the site list from the sensor data publications? 
```{r create site list}

##Description, Latitude, Longitude

Control <- data.frame(
  Description = "Control Plot at the TEMPEST experimental site. The TEMPEST experiment is in a mid- to late-successional (~80 years old) temperate, deciduous coastal forest.", 
  Latitude = "38.8747 degrees", 
  Longitude = "-76.5519 degrees")

Freshwater <- data.frame(
  Description = "Freshwater Plot at the TEMPEST experimental site. The TEMPEST experiment is in a mid- to late-successional (~80 years old) temperate, deciduous coastal forest.", 
  Latitude = "38.87403 degrees", 
  Longitude = "-76.5516 degrees")

Saltwater <- data.frame(
  Description = "Saltwater Plot at the TEMPEST experimental site. The TEMPEST experiment is in a mid- to late-successional (~80 years old) temperate, deciduous coastal forest.",
  Latitude = "38.8744 degrees", 
  Longitude = "-76.5525 degrees")

site_list = bind_rows(Control, Freshwater, Saltwater)

#write out the site list associated with the data:
write.csv(site_list, "Data package/site_list.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```


## Data Description - NEED TO EDIT THIS
```{r data description}

#Create a text file that has the description of the data - This ideally should match the text that is in the data READ.ME 

datadescription <- "These data are measurements of tree gas well samples collected in 2022-2025 from the COMPASS Terrestrial Ecosystem Manipulation to Probe the Effects of Storm Treatments (TEMPEST) site in the Chesapeake Bay region. This manipulative, ecosystem-scale TEMPEST experiment addresses the potential for freshwater and estuarine-water disturbance events to alter tree function, species composition, and ecosystem processes in a deciduous coastal forest in MD, USA. The experiment uses a large-unit (2000 m2), un-replicated experimental design, with three 50 m × 40 m plots serving as control, freshwater, and saltwater treatments. Trees were cored and had gas wells installed at breast height. Gas samples were collected from tree gas wells semi-monthly from 2022-2025, and 1-2 times per day during flooding events. The samples were stored in exetainers then analyzed for methane and carbon dioxide on a Varian 450 Gas Chromatograph. The methane is determined with an FID and the carbon dioxide with a TCD. Analysis of each constituent is described in the data dictionary and further details, including quality assurance and quality control for all analyses can be found on the COMPASS TEMPEST page (https://github.com/COMPASS-DOE/TEMPEST)"

#write to a text file 
writeLines(datadescription, "Data package/COMPASS_TEMPEST_TGW_DataDescription.txt")

```


## Create Author List - NEED TO EDIT THIS 
```{#r create author list}

#Pull in the common synoptic authors list: 
authors_common <- read.csv(here("Metadata/Synoptic CB/", "COMPASS_SynopticCB_common_essdive_author_list.csv"))


#create a list of the last names you want to pull 
names_we_want <- c("Wilson", "Read", "Stearns", "Phillips", "Chin", "Megonigal")

#Subset the common list for the names that we want 
author_list <- authors_common %>%
  filter(last_name %in% names_we_want)

#if you need to add any other authors 
others <- data.frame(
  first_name = c("first_name1", "first_name2"), 
  last_name = c("last_name1", "last_name2"), 
  orcid = c("orcid_id1", "orcid_id2"), 
  affiliation = c("affiliation1", "affiliation2"), 
  email = c("email1", "email2")
)

#add in the other authors 
#author_list <- bind_rows(author_list, others)

#write out the author list associated with the data:
write.csv(author_list, "Data package/author_list.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
